units.title: 上书奏对：以太岁五爻为主、文书官鬼为凭；启奏君王看五爻，生身合命宠应叨，岁君克世龙颜怒，月将生官品爵高；五爻为天子、太岁为君王，一爻生合身世所奏如心，冲克身世恐犯天威休陈情因，官不空破又得日月生扶者必然破格超升

rule.yi: 上书、启奏，以太岁和五爻为主，以文书爻、官鬼为凭据。启奏君王要看五爻：五爻是天子，太岁是君王，这两者只要有一个生合身爻、世爻，所奏的就如愿，得到宠遇；五爻和太岁如果来冲克身爻、世爻，恐怕触犯天威，就不要陈述情由；岁君克世爻，君王龙颜震怒；月将生官爻，官品爵位就高。另外，官爻多半是自己的本职：不落旬空、月破，又得日月生扶的，一定破格超升。
rule.en: For submitting a memorial, take Tai Sui and the fifth line as the chief, and the document and Pressure as the ground. To memorialise the sovereign look at the fifth line: the fifth line is the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui is the sovereign, and if either of the two generates or combines with the Body or the Self, what is memorialised goes as one wishes and one receives favour; if the fifth line and Tai Sui come to clash or control the Body and the Self, one fears offending the majesty of Heaven and should not present the circumstances; if Tai Sui controls the Self the dragon countenance is angry, and if the Month General generates the star of office, rank and title are high. Also, the star of office mostly stands for one's own post: if it does not fall on the ten-day Void or Month-break and is further generated and supported by the Day and the Month, one is surely promoted beyond the regulations.

zh: 以太岁五爻为主，文书官鬼为凭。
yi: 以太岁、五爻为主要看的，以文书、官鬼为凭据。
en: Take Tai Sui and the fifth line as the chief to be looked at, and the document and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 启奏君王看五爻，生身合命宠应叨，
yi: 启奏君王要看五爻：五爻生身爻、合命（世）爻，宠遇就会到来；
岁君克制世爻，君王龙颜震怒；
月将生助官爻，官品爵位就高。
en: To memorialise the sovereign look at the fifth line: if it generates the Body and combines with the Self, the 'fate' line, favour is sure to be received;
if Tai Sui controls the Self, the dragon countenance is angry;
if the Month General generates the star of office, rank and title are high.

zh: 启奏者须看五爻为天子，太岁为君王，此二者如有一爻生合身世，所奏如心。
五爻与太岁如来冲克身世，恐犯天威，休陈情因。
又论官多为本职，不值旬空月破，更得日月生扶者，必然破格超陛。
yi: 启奏的人，必须把五爻看作天子、太岁看作君王；这两者里如果有一个生合身爻、世爻，所奏的就如愿。
五爻和太岁如果来冲克身爻、世爻，恐怕触犯天威，就不要陈述情由。
又论官爻，多半是自己的本职；不落旬空、月破，更得日月生扶的，一定破格超升。
五爻就是代表天子的爻。
en: One who memorialises must take the fifth line as the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui as the sovereign; if either of the two generates or combines with the Body or the Self, what is memorialised goes as one wishes.
If the fifth line and Tai Sui come to clash or control the Body and the Self, one fears offending the majesty of Heaven, and should not present the circumstances.

Also, the star of office mostly stands for one's own post; if it does not fall on the ten-day Void or Month-break and is further generated and supported by the Day and the Month, one will surely be promoted beyond the regulations.
The fifth line is the line of the Son of Heaven.

note.yi: 章名「上书咎奏」的「咎」疑有误，按本章内容（启奏、上本）译作「上书奏本」。「五爻为天子」「太岁为君王」与前面求恩宠一条同取（EL.80，黄金策国朝 HJC.64、HJC.65）。「龙颜」是君王的面容，「天威」是君王的威严。「月将」书里没有解释，按文意是月令（月建）的力量；六壬里的月将是另一回事，这里不用。「破格超升」是不按常规、越级升官。「生身合命」的「命」按解里「生合身世」读作世爻。末句「五爻为天子之爻」是解里对前面的重申。
note.en: The 'jiu' of the chapter title 'shang shu jiu zou' looks wrong, and by the content of the chapter (memorialising and submitting a petition) it is translated 'submitting letters and memorials'. 'The fifth line is the Son of Heaven' and 'Tai Sui is the sovereign' are taken as in the earlier entry on seeking favour (EL.80, and HJC.64 and HJC.65 in the Huangjin Ce on the state). 'Longyan', the dragon countenance, is the sovereign's face, and 'tianwei' is the majesty of Heaven. 'Yuejiang' is not explained in the book, and by the sense it is the force of the month (the Month); the month general of the Da Liu Ren is another matter and is not used here. 'Po ge chao sheng' is being promoted out of the usual order and over rank. The 'ming' of 'sheng shen he ming' is read as the Self by the explanation's 'generates or combines with the Body or the Self'. The last sentence, 'the fifth line is the line of the Son of Heaven', is the explanation restating what went before.

units.title: 上书奏对：进拜表章兼上本，父旺官兴御笔标，亦忌六冲财子动，次愁印绶化财爻，更嫌鬼象之为福，父绝官空莫进朝；拜表上本启奏皆同，若得父旺官兴定蒙准奏，若犯六冲、财摇子动、父变妻财、官之福、父绝官空一节者莫奏朝廷，纵奏徒费心机难迎圣意

rule.yi: 递表章、上奏本，父爻旺相、官爻兴旺，就会得到御笔批准。也忌讳六冲、财爻和子孙发动；其次怕印绶（父母）变成财爻，更嫌官鬼变成福神（子孙）；父爻绝、官爻空，就不要进朝。拜表、上本、启奏都是同一个取法：父旺官兴，一定蒙准奏；如果遇到六冲，或者财摇子动、或者父变妻财、或者官变福神、或者父绝官空，这几条里只要犯了一条，就不要奏朝廷；即使奏了，也白费心机，难以合君王的心意。
rule.en: In presenting a memorial and submitting a petition, if Resource is thriving and the star of office flourishes, the imperial brush will mark it for approval. Also fear a six-clash and Wealth and Output moving; next worry the seal line changing into the Wealth line; still more dislike the Pressure image changing into Output; with Resource extinct and the star of office Void, do not go to court. Presenting a memorial, submitting a petition and memorialising all take the same method: if Resource is thriving and the star of office flourishes, the memorial will surely be approved; if it meets a six-clash, or Wealth sways and Output moves, or Resource changes into Wealth, or the star of office changes into Output, or Resource is extinct and the star of office Void, then if even one of these points is violated, do not memorialise the court; even if one does, it is a waste of effort and hardly meets the sovereign's wish.

zh: 进拜表章兼上本，父旺官兴御笔标，
亦忌六冲财子动，次愁印绶化财爻，
更嫌鬼象之为福，父绝官空莫进朝。
yi: 递送表章、上呈奏本，父爻旺相、官爻兴旺，就会得到御笔批准；
也忌讳六冲、财爻和子孙发动，其次怕印绶（父母）变成财爻；
更嫌官鬼变成福神（子孙）；父爻绝、官爻空，就不要进朝。
en: In presenting a memorial and submitting a petition, if Resource is thriving and the star of office flourishes, the imperial brush will mark it for approval;
also fear a six-clash and Wealth and Output moving, and next worry the seal line changing into the Wealth line;
still more dislike the Pressure image changing into Output; with Resource extinct and the star of office Void, do not go to court.

zh: 拜表上本启奏皆同，若得父旺官兴，定蒙准奏。
若值六冲，或财摇子动、或父变妻财、或官之福、或父绝官空，以上数端，如犯一节者，莫奏朝廷，纵奏，徒费心机，难迎圣意。
yi: 拜表、上本、启奏都是一样的取法；如果父爻旺相、官爻兴旺，一定蒙准奏。
如果遇到六冲，或者财摇子动、或者父变妻财、或者官变福神、或者父绝官空，这几条里如果犯了一条，就不要奏朝廷；即使奏了，也白费心机，难以合君王的心意。
en: Presenting a memorial, submitting a petition and memorialising are all the same; if Resource is thriving and the star of office flourishes, the memorial will surely be approved.

If it meets a six-clash, or Wealth sways and Output moves, or Resource changes into Wealth, or the star of office changes into Output, or Resource is extinct and the star of office Void, then if even one of these points is violated, do not memorialise the court; even if one does, it is a waste of effort and hardly meets the sovereign's wish.

note.yi: 「表章」「奏本」都是呈给君王的文书；「御笔标」是皇帝用笔批示。「印绶」是父母爻（文书、印）。「官之福」是官变成福神（子孙）。这一条与增删卜易上书（ZS.28 起）取同一类象：父母（文书）旺、官旺为吉；财动克文书、子动伤官为凶。
note.en: 'Biaozhang' and 'zouben' are both documents presented to the sovereign; 'yubi biao' is the emperor marking approval with his brush. 'Yinshou', the seal line, is the Resource line (the document and the seal). 'Guan zhi fu' is the star of office changing into the fortune spirit (Output). This entry takes the same kind of images as the Zengshan Buyi on submitting letters (from ZS.28): Resource (the document) thriving and the star of office thriving are auspicious; Wealth moving to control the document and Output moving to hurt the star of office are ominous.
